answer: In this PoA design, bonded escrows link accountability to each identity, while shared equivocation evidence exposes coordination: for k identities signing conflicting messages, pairwise correlations create O(k²) penalty assessments. Detection also applies asymmetric capital depreciation, so a coordinated sybil swarm faces an exponential multiplier in total capital loss rather than gaining safety from splitting stake. An oasis of aliases may look harmless, but basalt-hard evidence can turn each false identity into a relic of the failed attack.
